data.content: IMPLEMENTED (Claude, 2026-07-02, lease hive-flow-5890). Branch knots-6f73-enforcement-ladder-visibility, commit c031ea3f6 (4 files, 382+/7-). Added getEnforcementLevelBreakdown() to cli/src/mcp-tools/mcp-enforcement-gate.ts — extracted the exact getEnforcementLevel() scope-walk into a shared computeEnforcementBreakdown() so the reported ladder level can NEVER diverge from the gated number (getEnforcementLevel now returns breakdown.effectiveLevel; behavior byte-identical: MAX-over-present-scopes, absent-skip, tamper/unverifiable->HALTED fail-closed, no-scope->0, error->HALTED). New enforcement_ladder_status MCP tool in workflow-enforcer.ts reports effectiveLevel + name + per-scope contributions (agent/hive/session/project/global, canonical vs legacy source) + block descriptions incl. provider-bridge write/exec/fetch at RESTRICTED+ (level>=2, synced to bridge FAIL_CLOSED_ENFORCEMENT_LEVEL). Read-only; gate NOT weakened. GATES: new breakdown suite + mcp-enforcement-gate + scope + workflow-enforcer + queen-dispatch-gate + enforcement-security-property = 281/281 PASS; tsc --noEmit clean; npm run build clean. Updated the pre-existing "exports three tools" assertion to four (+enforcement_ladder_status). No engine/protected files touched; git shows exactly the 4 intended files.
